versions.changelog: v1.2.2: Added support for Xiaohongshu (小红书) publishing skills with keywords like '小红书', 'xiaohongshu', 'red', '笔记发布'. Now recommends Xiaohongshu Publisher and Social Media Manager for Chinese social media management needs.
v1.2.1: Added support for YouTube download skills with keywords like 'youtube', '视频下载', 'yt下载'. Now recommends YouTube Downloader and Video Transcript Downloader for video downloading needs.

v1.2.0: Added real-time ClawHub API integration, expanded skill database with rich text processing and multimedia skills, improved query matching for specific domains like富文本处理, Web content extraction, and creative media processing.
Initial release: AI Capability Analyzer - 智能分析用户需求并推荐最适合的ClawHub AI/ML技能，提供技能比较、安全评估和使用建议。
